job_store.description: The job store location. Can be a local path (file:./store), AWS S3 (aws:region:bucket), or Google Cloud Storage (gce:project:bucket).

batch_system.description: The batch system to run jobs on. Supported systems include single_machine, slurm, kubernetes, lsf, torque, htcondor, grid_engine, and mesos.

clean.description: Determines deletion of the jobStore upon completion. Choices: 'always', 'onError', 'never', or 'onSuccess'.

default_memory.description: The default memory requirement for jobs that do not specify an explicit value. Standard suffixes like K, M, G are supported.

default_cores.description: The default number of CPU cores for jobs. Fractions of a core are supported on some batch systems.

default_disk.description: The default disk space requirement for jobs that do not specify an explicit value.

retry_count.description: Number of times to retry a failing job before giving up.

log_level.description: The logging level. Choices: OFF, ERROR, WARNING, INFO, DEBUG, TRACE.

log_file.description: Path to a file to write the main logging output to. Empty string disables file logging.

write_logs.description: Directory to write worker logs into. Empty string disables per-job log files.

work_dir.description: Absolute path to directory where temporary files are placed. Empty string uses system default.

enable_stats.description: If true, records statistics about the workflow for later analysis with toil stats.

restart.description: If true, attempts to restart an existing workflow from the specified job store.

max_jobs.description: Maximum number of jobs to submit to the scheduler at once. 0 means unlimited.

max_memory.description: Maximum amount of memory to request from the batch system. 0 means unlimited.

max_cores.description: Maximum number of CPU cores to request. 0 means unlimited. Standard suffixes like G, Mi apply.

max_disk.description: Maximum amount of disk space to request. 0 means unlimited.

config_file.description: Path to an external Toil configuration YAML file. Empty string uses defaults.
